text: Laravel 14, the next major release of the framework, is expected in **Q1 2027** and has not yet officially shipped or announced a final feature list [1][2]. Based on current development, it will require a minimum PHP version of **8.4** and is projected to receive bug fixes until **Q3 2028** and security updates until **Q1 2029** [1]. Anticipated changes include the introduction of **`Route::query()`** for handling HTTP `QUERY` method requests, which will be treated as read requests by the CSRF middleware and included in `Route::any()` [1]. Dependency updates will see `ably/ably-php` transition to protocol 2.0 and `orchestra/testbench-core` move to `^12.0`, with support for PHPUnit versions 11.5, 12.5, and 13 [1]. Following the trajectory of Laravel 13, which focused on AI-native workflows and expressive APIs, Laravel 14 is also expected to continue building out **AI and vector-search capabilities** and will likely remove features that were marked deprecated during the Laravel 13.x release cycle [3][2].
